rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an unrealistic idea, plan, or expectation.

example.traditional: 你個計劃太唔切實際喇。
example.jyutping: nei5 go3 gai3 waak6 taai3 m4 cit3 sat6 zai3 laa3

rows.note: Use this when stressing that something is not grounded in reality or cannot work in real life.

example.english: Thinking you can save enough for a down payment in one month is unrealistic.
example.traditional: 諗住一個月內儲夠首期，真係唔現實。
example.jyutping: nam2 zyu6 jat1 go3 jyut6 noi6 cou5 gau3 sau2 kei4 zan1 hai6 m4 jin6 sat6

rows.note: Use this for an unrealistic portrayal, story, or impression that does not feel true to life.

example.english: The police character in the movie is too unrealistic.
example.traditional: 套戲入面個警察角色太唔真實喇。
example.jyutping: tou3 hei3 jap6 min6 go3 ging2 caat3 gok3 sik1 taai3 m4 zan1 sat6 laa3
